threshold 25.0)","sql":"calculate_uplift_or_stats: analysis='kyc_changepoint', platform='android', doc_type='passport'"}],"recommended_action":"ROLLBACK_RELEASE","reasoning_summary":"The overall approval rate broke downward on 2025-11-13 from 0.889 to 0.821, with a strong changepoint signal (LLR 119.5 vs threshold 25.0). The clearest cause is Android national IDs: the break begins 2025-11-10, coincident with v5.27, and approval falls from 0.855083 on v5.26 to 0.619533 on v5.27 while unreadable rejections rise from 88 to 684. No comparable changepoint appears for iOS national IDs or Android passports; v5.28 is still low at 0.628611, so roll back the affected Android release and investigate document readability."}
